name: Black Channel Marsh
summary: Raptors prowl Black Channel Marsh beside the road to Menethil Harbor. The mire lies in the Wetlands’ southwest, where travelers and couriers face danger along the coast.

sections.title: Peril on the Menethil Road
sections.body: Black Channel Marsh spreads across the low ground southwest of the main road to Menethil Harbor. Caravan drivers and couriers know the danger there. The raised road may seem safe, but territorial raptors live among the stagnant channels and thick reeds. Hungry beasts often stray into the road, ambushing recruits and weary travelers who wander even a little from the path.

faq.q: Where is Black Channel Marsh located?
faq.answer: Black Channel Marsh lies in the southwestern Wetlands, along the southern side of the main road into Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Why is this marsh considered dangerous for travelers?
faq.answer: Raptors lair throughout the marsh and hunt near its edge. They prowl close to the road, catching travelers and inexperienced adventurers unaware.

faq.q: Who travels through here most often?
faq.answer: Alliance messengers, dwarven merchants, and travelers going between Ironforge and Menethil Harbor’s docks often use the road beside the marsh.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can track or tame fierce Wetlands raptors beside the main road, though the marsh makes dangerous ground.
As an Alliance traveler, you rely on this road to connect Menethil Harbor with the rest of Khaz Modan, while raptors remain a constant danger.
